notes:
All 8 review findings from review1-setup-format.json (1,2,5,6,7,8) plus item 9 (letter template) implemented; findings 3 and 4 were already settled in docs and untouched.

(1) SetupPackage.Read and ExtractTo now call Checks.EnsureAcceptable() as their first statement (after the ObjectDisposedException check), so no entry can be decrypted out of a file whose checks did not all pass. TryRead/ReadLogo/ReadGuide/ReadReportTemplate/ReadLetterTemplate inherit the gate through Read. Added SetupPackage.ReadLogoPreviewFromRejectedFile(), which deliberately bypasses the gate: W03's spec (B1-admin-firstrun.md) shows an organisation card with the logo next to the check list, and that card has to work even when a later item (another device, an older export) is what gets refused — by the time a SetupPackage object exists at all, the signature and package password have already held, so only the logo (which carries no secret) is exposed this way. Documented the reasoning in its XML doc.

(2) SetupExpectations.StagingDirectory and SetupWriteRequest.StagingDirectory are now required: SetupPackageReader.Validate and SetupPackageWriter.Prepare throw CryptoException(Corrupt) when null/empty. XML docs on both properties now say the host must pass its own protected folder. Scoped to the Setup layer only, per the finding — ContainerOpenOptions/ContainerWriteRequest.StagingDirectory stay optional for every other container kind.

(5) SetupWriteRequest.Kdf changed from public to internal — production callers outside Wakeel.Crypto/Wakeel.Crypto.Tests can no longer set it at all, so every setup file built from outside this project gets Argon2Params.CreateDefault() (64MB/3/2) via BuildRequest's `request.Kdf ?? Argon2Params.CreateDefault()`. The test assembly reaches the internal property through the existing InternalsVisibleTo.

(6) Added ContainerReader.ReadEntryTo(name, key, destination) which streams a decrypted entry straight into a caller-supplied Stream without ever materializing it as a byte[]; SetupPackage.ReadTo(entryName, Stream) forwards to it (gated by EnsureAcceptable, same as Read). SetupPackage.Read now only caches entries at or below the new public const MaxCachedEntrySize (1 MB); entries at or above it are decrypted fresh on every call and never retained.

(7) SetupPackageReader.Examine now special-cases chainError == ErrorCode.Expired from the certificate-chain check: records Signature Ok and Package/FutureDate, matching the container-open path's treatment of the same underlying fact (a root certificate whose IssuedAt sits more than a day ahead of the clock).

(8) ContainerReader.Open now bounds manifest.json and signature.bin reads to 1 MB via a streaming ReadAll(entry, limit) that throws CryptoException(Corrupt) as soon as the limit is exceeded — enforced during decompression, mirroring CopyWithLimit on the payload side.

(9) SetupIncludes gained a fourth field LetterTemplate; SetupEntryNames.LetterTemplate = "letter-template.docx"; SetupCheckItem gained LetterTemplate (sibling of ReportTemplate); SetupChecker's allowlist and Optional() check extended; SetupPackageWriter gained a LetterTemplate stream factory; SetupPackage gained ReadLetterTemplate(). Round-trip tests cover both with and without it.

Test suite grew from 212 to 224 (12 new facts: 10 in SetupPackageTests.cs, 2 in ContainerTests.cs for the manifest.json/signature.bin size bound). All 224 tests pass; build is clean with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true (0 warnings, 0 errors) via `dotnet build src/Wakeel.Crypto` and `dotnet test tests/Wakeel.Crypto.Tests`. Only files under src/Wakeel.Crypto and tests/Wakeel.Crypto.Tests were touched; no NuGet packages added; no other paths modified.
